test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All thermometers are rockets.

All equipment are thermometers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some rockets are equipment.

II. Some rockets are thermometers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
__**The Least possible Venn Diagram**__:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9efdc3be60e5947a61e9f5b1ab97725620b30e5e9380832deb24b50b82f6bbc8.png] 

**Conclusions:**

**I: **Some rockets are equipment → **Follow** (As all equipment are thermometer and all thermometer are rockets so, some rockets are definitely equipment).

**II: **Some rockets are thermometers → **Follow **(As all thermometer are rockets so, some rockets are definitely thermometers)

Hence, the correct answer is **"**Both conclusions I and II follow**"**.
